Population increased in Torbay

The estimated population of Torbay in 2024 was 140,126 usual residents, a rise of 0.3% since 2023.

This meant that Torbay's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Torbay increased by 0.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, Torbay was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Torbay

The average (median) age fell to 49.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Torbay has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Torbay is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Torbay's population of 140,126 usual residents was made up of:

  • 21,686 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.5%)
  • 80,206 people aged 16 to 64 years, (57.2%)
  • 38,234 people aged 65 years and over, (27.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Torbay has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (27.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Torbay, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from births and deaths.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Torbay
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Torbay, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 918 people (-0.7%). In total, there were 970 births and 1,888 deaths in Torbay.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 505 (0.4%). There were 6,856 people entering the area and 6,351 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Torbay's population of 778 (0.6%) as a result of 1,106 people entering the area and 328 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Torbay was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Torbay in mid-2023 is 139,744.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 283 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 24 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 259 people.
